title: Login with valid corporate credentials
business_objective: Verify users can access the system to perform daily business tasks
preconditions:
1. Application is accessible
2. Test user account exists
3. User is logged out
test_steps:
1. Navigate to login page
2. Enter valid email: testuser@example.com
3. Enter valid password
4. Click Sign In button
5. Verify dashboard displays with welcome message
expected_result: User sees the main dashboard with their name displayed and welcome message
validation_points: Login form displays with email and password fields; User is redirected to dashboard; Welcome message with user name displayed; Navigation menu is visible
playwright_commands:
playwright-cli open https://app.example.com/login
playwright-cli fill e5 "testuser@example.com"
playwright-cli fill e7 "ValidPass123!"
playwright-cli click e9
playwright-cli snapshot --filename=TC-AUTH-001-dashboard.yaml

title: Login fails with invalid credentials
business_objective: Verify system prevents unauthorized access and provides clear feedback
preconditions:
1. Application is accessible
2. User is logged out
test_steps:
1. Navigate to login page
2. Enter invalid email: invalid@example.com
3. Enter wrong password
4. Click Sign In button
5. Observe error message displayed
expected_result: Error message displays indicating invalid credentials; user remains on login page
validation_points: Login form displays; Error message is visible and clear; User stays on login page; No navigation to dashboard
playwright_commands:
playwright-cli open https://app.example.com/login
playwright-cli fill e5 "invalid@example.com"
playwright-cli fill e7 "wrongpassword"
playwright-cli click e9
playwright-cli screenshot --filename=TC-AUTH-002-error.png

title: Login form validates empty required fields
business_objective: Verify form prevents submission without required information
test_steps:
1. Navigate to login page
2. Leave all fields empty
3. Click Sign In button
4. Observe validation error messages
expected_result: Validation errors appear for required fields; form is not submitted; user stays on login page
validation_points: Error messages shown for email and password; Form not submitted; User stays on login page
playwright_commands:
playwright-cli open https://app.example.com/login
playwright-cli click e9
playwright-cli screenshot --filename=TC-AUTH-003-validation.png

title: Request password reset via email
business_objective: Verify users can recover account access when they forget their password
preconditions:
1. Application is accessible
2. Valid user email exists in system
test_steps:
1. Navigate to login page
2. Click 'Forgot Password' link
3. Enter email: testuser@example.com
4. Click Submit button
5. Observe confirmation message
expected_result: Confirmation message displays indicating reset instructions have been sent
validation_points: Password reset form displays; Email field accepts input; Confirmation message visible after submit
playwright_commands:
playwright-cli open https://app.example.com/login
playwright-cli click e10
playwright-cli fill e15 "testuser@example.com"
playwright-cli click e16
playwright-cli screenshot --filename=TC-AUTH-004-confirm.png
comments: Email delivery not directly verifiable in UAT; confirm screen message only

title: New user completes registration successfully
business_objective: Verify new users can create an account to access the platform
preconditions:
1. Application is accessible
2. Email not already registered
test_steps:
1. Navigate to registration page
2. Enter first name: John
3. Enter last name: Doe
4. Enter email: newuser@example.com
5. Enter password: SecurePass123!
6. Confirm password: SecurePass123!
7. Accept terms checkbox
8. Click Register button
9. Observe registration confirmation
test_data: First name: John, Last name: Doe, Email: newuser@example.com, Password: SecurePass123!
expected_result: Registration successful message displays; user is informed about verification email
validation_points: Registration form displays all fields; Password strength indicator shows strong; Passwords match confirmation; Terms checkbox is checked; Registration success message visible
playwright_commands:
playwright-cli open https://app.example.com/register
playwright-cli fill e5 "John"
playwright-cli fill e6 "Doe"
playwright-cli fill e7 "newuser@example.com"
playwright-cli fill e8 "SecurePass123!"
playwright-cli fill e9 "SecurePass123!"
playwright-cli check e10
playwright-cli click e11
playwright-cli screenshot --filename=TC-REG-001-success.png

title: Dashboard displays all summary widgets after login
business_objective: Verify users can view key business metrics and activity at a glance
preconditions:
1. User is logged in
2. User has data to display
test_steps:
1. Complete successful login
2. Wait for dashboard to fully load
3. Verify metrics widget displays current values
4. Verify recent activity widget shows entries
5. Verify notifications count is displayed
expected_result: Dashboard renders with all widgets showing current data; metrics, activity, and notifications are visible
validation_points: Dashboard page loads completely; Metrics widget shows values; Activity list is populated; Notification count is displayed
playwright_commands:
playwright-cli open https://app.example.com/login
playwright-cli fill e5 "testuser@example.com"
playwright-cli fill e7 "ValidPass123!"
playwright-cli click e9
playwright-cli snapshot --filename=TC-DASH-001-dashboard.yaml
playwright-cli screenshot --filename=TC-DASH-001-full.png
comments: May require longer wait for async widget loads

title: All main navigation links load correct pages
business_objective: Verify users can navigate to all sections of the application
test_steps:
1. Click Dashboard link and verify page loads
2. Click Reports link and verify page loads
3. Click Settings link and verify page loads
4. Click Profile link and verify page loads
expected_result: Each navigation link loads the expected page with correct heading and content
validation_points: Dashboard page loads with title; Reports page loads with title; Settings page loads with title; Profile page loads with title
playwright_commands:
playwright-cli click [data-nav="dashboard"]
playwright-cli screenshot --filename=TC-NAV-001-dashboard.png
playwright-cli click [data-nav="reports"]
playwright-cli screenshot --filename=TC-NAV-001-reports.png
playwright-cli click [data-nav="settings"]
playwright-cli screenshot --filename=TC-NAV-001-settings.png
playwright-cli click [data-nav="profile"]
playwright-cli screenshot --filename=TC-NAV-001-profile.png
